entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 3979226627820659072: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 56508: distance 135.938 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.082), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 135.938 +/- 11.147 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 7.2345 +/- 0.0294 mas (same row, RUWE 1.18), 245.7 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -59.897, -0.996 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 9.726 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 56508: radius 9.726 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 45.227 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.097) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 4803 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 56508: effective temperature 4803 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.132).
